reviews.text:
I took my dog ​​Gus, a Maltese, and I noticed a huge difference in everything. When I picked him up, he was playing and happy, and he'd never looked so well cared for, with such a shiny coat.
I highly recommend this place because they don't just cut their hair; you can tell they pamper them and give them the treatments they need. They are pure love ❤️ for our furry friends 🐕
The girls were wonderful and they left my dog ​​looking perfect and smelling amazing ❤️

A gorgeous haircut for our little Clemmie. We loved that from the moment you walk in, you realize it's a peaceful place for animals where they do everything possible to make the creatures happy and provide them with excellent service. You can tell right away when the people doing the work are happy and when that happiness rubs off on the animals. We'll definitely be back.
Not just expensive, it's outrageously expensive. Good service, but hold on to your wallet, you've been warned.

Thank you so much for those 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐💗
We were so thrilled to receive them, although we're a little curious… we'd love to know who you are and which little one has been in our care! 🐶✨

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for trusting Kristylcan and for taking a moment to rate us. We hope to see you again very soon! 🥰

The Kristylcan team was professional, attentive, and friendly at all times. My dog, a long-haired dachshund, was incredibly comfortable and happy during his spa treatment and came out looking impeccable. The service was outstanding; I highly recommend it.
The best pet groomer in all of Valencia! Incredible service, they treat Row very well and leave him looking radiant. Thank you for everything!

I took my little Cobberdog for his first haircut, and all the girls were super friendly and attentive, always with a smile. My little guy was very happy and, from what they told me, he behaved very well 😊 and they made him look super handsome 🥰😍. Thank you so much!
My experience with Nikita, my 5-month-old Cavapoo puppy, has been wonderful. 🥰 …
They were so attentive, they made Thanos look even more beautiful than he already is!!! ☺️☺️ We'll definitely be back. Thank you!
